summary: Preinstall alternate-runtime dropper: downloads Bun and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package's preinstall hook (scripts.preinstall = "node setup.mjs") runs an obfuscated setup.mjs that downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<platform>.zip, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and then invokes the sibling file math_init.js under that freshly downloaded Bun interpreter. math_init.js is a ~727KB obfuscated Bun-CJS bundle (header `// @bun @bun-cjs`, hex-named globals, ~7000-element mixed constants array, array-rotation deobfuscator `WV8StW`) that is not referenced by index.js, the bin scripts, or any documented API of this Lerna config helper. setup.mjs itself is obfuscator.io-shaped (hex-named identifiers `_0x488df8`, `_0x52943e`, `_0x24db8d`, per-function string-lookup decoy objects), hiding the dropper mechanics. The package's stated purpose (a Lerna configuration helper) does not require Bun or a bundled obfuscated payload; using an alternate runtime to execute the payload also bypasses Node-oriented install-time scanners. Installing this version causes attacker-controlled code to execute automatically on the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
